captions.detailed: This 3D model features a compact olive-green spotting scope mounted on a dark grey alt-azimuth tripod. The scope body consists of a cylindrical objective housing with a light blue lens surface, connected to a narrower eyepiece body. It is supported by a U-shaped altitude fork that tilts vertically, which is in turn mounted on a cylindrical panning head that rotates continuously on the tripod base.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact spotting scope on an alt-azimuth tripod. The spotting scope should have an olive-green cylindrical body with a blue glass lens, mounted on a dark grey U-shaped altitude fork. The fork must connect to a panning head that sits atop three slender, angled tripod legs, allowing for rotational and tilting movements.
captions.factory: The code constructs the object using an assembly of parts. The tripod base is built using cylindrical primitives for the central hub and three thin cylinders angled outwards for the legs. The panning head uses stacked cylinders. The U-shaped altitude mount is modeled using box primitives for the brackets and a horizontal cylinder for the pivot. The spotting scope is constructed from concentric cylinders of varying diameters to form the objective lens, main body, and eyepiece, combined with a flat circular disc for the lens face.
